metadata.title: Evaluation
metadata.description: Use this bot page to start and manage runs after a published dataset version already exists.

hero_title: Runs live here. The evaluation entry does not.
hero_description: This page is the run view for one bot. Bring a published dataset version from Collection > Evaluation, start the run here, then inspect progress and item-level traces.
step_create_run: Create a run for this bot
runs_scope_description: Keep creation lightweight here: choose a published dataset version and launch the run.
runs_scope_helper: Use this page to operate runs for the current bot. Dataset creation still starts from the collection side.
runs_panel_description: Track what this bot has already run, then drill into progress, items, retries, and traces.
runs_section_description: Every run on this page belongs to the current bot. Start new runs with a published dataset version, then use run detail to inspect execution and recover failed items.
items_description: Each item reflects one benchmark case and its latest execution attempt.
search_placeholder: Search runs, cases, or trace ids
empty_description: Bring a published dataset version from Collection > Evaluation, then start the first run for this bot here.
create_run_description: Launch a run for this bot with one published dataset version. Keep the first run small so the whole path is easy to validate.
create_run_helper: Need a dataset version id first? Start in Collection > Evaluation, create a dataset, publish the first version, then come back here.
empty_detail_title: Run details are not available yet
empty_detail_description: The run detail endpoint is reachable, but this run has not returned structured data yet.
empty_items_description: Items will appear after the run is created and the worker starts dispatching attempts.
error_title: Evaluation data could not be loaded
error_description: The evaluation endpoint returned an error. Please retry after the backend contract and server state are checked.
not_available_title: Evaluation APIs are not ready yet
not_available_description: The UI is ready. Data and actions will appear here once the evaluation v2 endpoints are merged.
